name: cross-repo-browser-test
description: Test a change end to end in the browser when it spans several connected services or repositories: a frontend MR/PR plus the API branch it calls, workers, queues, mail, webhooks and seeded data. Sets up the local stack on the right branches, routes side effects (mail, webhooks, payments) to safe local sinks, creates the dummy data the screens need, drives the UI in the built-in browser, cross-checks every number against the DB/API, and reports what works, what broke, and what was not covered. Use whenever the user wants to "test this MR/branch locally", "set up the environment to test X", "does this need dummy data", "check the feature works with the API", or asks to verify a review against real behaviour — even if they don't say "browser" or name the other services.
